title: Engineering (B.Tech / B.E.)
summary: A 4-year degree in branches such as computer science, mechanical, civil, electrical and electronics. Admission is mostly through national or state entrance exams and counselling.
qualification: 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Maths, with minimum marks set by each exam and college.

entrance_exams.name: JEE Main (NITs, IIITs and many colleges)

opportunities: Software, IT services and product companies
Core engineering jobs in manufacturing, construction, energy
Government and PSU jobs through GATE or direct recruitment
next_steps: Check eligibility and dates of JEE Main and your state CET on their official sites.
Plan for counselling: list colleges and branches in order of preference.
Look at scholarships for engineering students on this site.

title: B.Sc. (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology and more)
summary: A 3-year science degree that leads to M.Sc., research, teaching, and many science and technology jobs. Good if you like understanding how things work.
qualification: 12th in Science (subject requirements vary by course).

entrance_exams.name: CUET UG (central universities and many others)
University or college merit lists and state processes

opportunities: Lab and quality jobs in industry
next_steps: Check CUET UG and your state university admission process.
Choose subjects you can take forward to M.Sc.
Plan for NET or GATE if research is your goal.

title: Architecture (B.Arch.)
summary: A 5-year professional degree in designing buildings and spaces. Needs both maths and drawing or design aptitude.
qualification: 12th with Maths, and an aptitude test for architecture.
opportunities: Architect in a firm, after registration with the Council of Architecture
next_steps: Check NATA and JEE Paper 2 eligibility and dates.
Build a small drawing and design portfolio.
Confirm that the college is recognised by the Council of Architecture.

title: National Defence Academy (NDA) and defence entry after 12th
summary: NDA trains young people for officer careers in the Army, Navy and Air Force. Selection is by a written exam and an SSB interview. Medical fitness matters.
qualification: 12th pass. Army wing: any stream. Air Force and Naval wings: Physics and Maths. Age limits and gender rules are set in each UPSC notification.

entrance_exams.name: NDA and NA exam by UPSC

opportunities: Commissioned officer in the armed forces
Free training and a degree through the academy
next_steps: Read the UPSC NDA notification for age, eligibility and dates.
Start physical fitness training and prepare for the written exam.
Learn about the SSB interview process on the official defence recruitment sites.

title: BCA / B.Sc. (Computer Science / IT)
summary: A 3-year degree in computer applications or science that leads to IT jobs, a master's in computers (MCA), or your own tech work.
qualification: 12th pass. Some colleges ask for Maths; check each college.

entrance_exams.name: University or college entrance or merit

next_steps: Learn programming basics in free time (SWAYAM, NPTEL).
Check CUET UG and university admission dates.
Build small projects to show in interviews.

title: Merchant Navy (marine engineering and nautical science)
summary: A career at sea on cargo ships, or on shore in the shipping sector. Needs medical fitness and a recognised maritime course.
qualification: 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Maths for most courses. Age and medical rules apply.
opportunities: Deck or engine officer on ships
next_steps: Check that your chosen institute is approved by the Directorate General of Shipping.
Read the entrance exam notification.
Check the medical fitness standards before you apply.

title: MBBS (doctor)
summary: A 5.5-year medical degree (including internship) that leads to becoming a doctor. Admission is by NEET-UG and counselling.
qualification: 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Biology (or Biotechnology), with minimum marks and age rules in the NEET notification.
courses: Then MD/MS through NEET-PG, or practise as a general doctor
opportunities: Doctor in government or private hospitals
next_steps: Read the NEET-UG notification each year for dates and eligibility.
Prepare for counselling: all-India and state quotas are separate.
Look at scholarships for medical students on this site.

title: BDS (dentist)
summary: A 5-year dental degree through NEET-UG. Dentists work in clinics, hospitals, or run their own practice.
qualification: 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, and a qualifying NEET-UG score.
next_steps: Follow the NEET-UG notification and counselling schedule.
Check that the dental college is recognised.

title: AYUSH courses (BAMS, BHMS, BUMS and others)
summary: Degrees in Ayurveda, Homoeopathy, Unani and other traditional systems of medicine. Admission is through NEET-UG and AYUSH counselling.
qualification: 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, and a qualifying NEET-UG score.
next_steps: Follow the NEET-UG notification and the AYUSH counselling announcements.
Check that the college is recognised.

title: B.Sc. Nursing
summary: A 4-year degree for nurses, with strong demand in India and abroad. Admission route differs by state, so check your state's process.
qualification: 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, with minimum marks as set by the Indian Nursing Council and your state.

entrance_exams.name: State nursing admission process or entrance exam (varies by state)

opportunities: Nursing abroad, subject to each country's registration rules
next_steps: Check your state's nursing admission notification.
Choose a college recognised by the Indian Nursing Council.

title: Pharmacy (D.Pharm / B.Pharm)
summary: Courses in medicines and drug sciences, leading to a pharmacist licence, pharma industry jobs, or your own medical store.
qualification: 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Maths. Requirements differ by course.
next_steps: Check the Pharmacy Council of India's approved colleges.
Read your state CET admission rules.

title: Veterinary Science (B.V.Sc. & A.H.)
summary: A 5-year degree to become a veterinary doctor for pets, livestock and dairy animals. Admission is through NEET-UG.
qualification: 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, and a qualifying NEET-UG score.
next_steps: Follow the NEET-UG notification and veterinary counselling.
Check that the college is recognised by the Veterinary Council of India.

title: B.Sc. Agriculture and allied degrees
summary: A 4-year degree on crops, soil, farm machinery, horticulture and agri-business. Leads to government agriculture posts, agri-companies, and modern farming.
qualification: 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Maths. Check each university.
next_steps: Check the ICAR and state agricultural university admission notices.
Look at government schemes for farmers and agri-entrepreneurs on this site.

title: Allied health sciences (lab technology, radiology, physiotherapy, optometry)
summary: Degrees and diplomas that support doctors and hospitals, such as medical lab technology, radiology, physiotherapy and optometry. Demand is steady.
qualification: 12th in Science (usually with Biology). Rules differ by course and state.
courses: Diploma courses in OT and dialysis technology
opportunities: Own lab or clinic after experience
Opportunities abroad subject to registration rules
next_steps: Check which regulator or council covers your chosen course.
Compare government and private colleges on fees and clinical training.

title: B.Com / BBA / BMS
summary: 3-year degrees in commerce and business. B.Com is strong on accounts and finance; BBA and BMS focus on management.
qualification: 12th pass. Commerce background helps but most colleges accept other streams.
courses: B.Com with CA or CS foundation

entrance_exams.name: State or university admission, mostly merit based

opportunities: MBA, CA, CS, CMA, M.Com after the degree
next_steps: Check CUET UG and your university's admission rules.
Combine your degree with CA, CS or CMA foundation if you want a professional qualification.

title: Professional courses: CA, CS, CMA
summary: Self-paced professional qualifications in accounting, company law and cost accounting. They need hard work but have low tuition costs compared with many degrees.
qualification: Registration after 12th (foundation level) or after a degree for later levels. Check each institute's rules.
courses: Cost and Management Accountant (CMA) by ICMAI
next_steps: Read the registration and exam schedule on the institute's website.
Study the syllabus before you commit to one course.

title: BA (Humanities and Social Sciences)
summary: A 3-year degree in subjects such as History, Political Science, Economics, Sociology, Psychology and languages. A strong base for civil services, teaching and media.
qualification: 12th pass in any stream.
courses: Integrated BA+MA courses at some universities
next_steps: Check CUET UG and your state university admission.
Start preparing for civil services or other exams alongside college, if you want.

title: Law (5-year integrated LL.B. or 3-year LL.B.)
summary: Law degrees lead to practice as an advocate, judiciary exams, corporate legal roles and civil services. A 5-year course starts after 12th; a 3-year LL.B. is taken after any degree.
qualification: 12th (for the 5-year course) or a bachelor's degree (for the 3-year course).
courses: BA LL.B / BBA LL.B / B.Com LL.B (5 years)

entrance_exams.name: State law CETs, for example Maharashtra

opportunities: Judiciary through state judicial service exams
Civil services, legal advisor to government
next_steps: Check CLAT and your state CET notifications.
Choose a college approved by the Bar Council of India.

title: Design courses (fashion, product, communication, UX)
summary: Design courses train you to create products, graphics, fashion, digital experiences and more. Admission is mostly through design aptitude exams.
qualification: 12th in any stream for most design exams. Check each exam's rules.
opportunities: Designer in studios, brands and tech companies
next_steps: Read the NIFT, UCEED and NID notifications for dates.
Build a simple portfolio of drawings and design ideas.

title: Mass communication and journalism
summary: Degrees in journalism, media, advertising and public relations. Good for writers, speakers and storytellers.
qualification: 12th in any stream.
courses: BA in Journalism and Mass Communication
PG diplomas at institutes such as IIMC
opportunities: Content writer, social media and PR roles
next_steps: Start writing: a blog, school or college magazine, or local stories.
Check CUET UG and university admissions.

title: Teaching (D.El.Ed, B.Ed, TET and NET)
summary: Teaching is a stable, respected career. Primary teachers train after 12th; secondary teachers need a degree plus B.Ed; college lecturers need a master's and NET.
qualification: 12th for D.El.Ed or integrated B.Ed; a bachelor's degree for B.Ed; a master's plus NET for college posts.
next_steps: Check NCTE-recognised teacher training colleges.
Read TET and CTET notifications.
Choose subjects you can teach well.

title: Hotel management and hospitality
summary: A 3-year degree in running hotels, restaurants, events and travel businesses. Good for people who like service and travel.
qualification: 12th in any stream.
courses: Diploma courses in food production and bakery
opportunities: Airlines, cruise lines and event companies
next_steps: Read the NCHM JEE notification.
Visit local hotels or restaurants to see the work first-hand.

title: SSC exams (CHSL after 12th, CGL after graduation)
summary: The Staff Selection Commission recruits for many central government clerical and officer posts. CHSL is for 12th pass; CGL is for graduates.
qualification: 12th pass for CHSL; any bachelor's degree for CGL. Age limits apply.
opportunities: Clerical and assistant posts in ministries and departments
Inspector, auditor and tax assistant posts through CGL
next_steps: Read the SSC exam calendar and notifications.
Practise with previous papers.
Keep a document set ready (certificates, ID, photos).
